relationships.subject: Bmp signaling
relationships.evidence_quote: The Bmp signal propagates inside the cell by phosphorylating Smad1/5/8, the receptor regulated (R) Smad secondary messengers

relationships.subject: Bmp signaling
relationships.evidence_quote: Studies in both chicken spinal cord and mESC assays, have shown that Bmp signaling induces Wnt1 expression

relationships.subject: β-catenin
relationships.evidence_quote: Mice lacking β‐catenin show reduced expression of Olig3, which is normally present in dP1–dP3, while the ubiquitous expression of β‐catenin leads to the expanded expression of Olig3

key_findings: Review: dorsal spinal interneuron (dI1-dI6) fates are specified by signal-specific Bmp, Wnt and retinoic acid activities rather than a Bmp morphogen gradient.
Stem cell-derived dI4-dI6 neurons, which mediate pain and itch, are proposed as platforms for non-opioid analgesic discovery.
